text: Acceptance 2: concurrent completions overwrite tombstones. In-memory ui-t16-storage repro: seed B's b1/b2; pause B1.persistUnsent(5,['b1']) after reading atalks_unsent_done_2, run B2.persistUnsent(5,['b2']), then resume B1. Tombstones become ['b1']; reload restores ['b2'], expected []. Store completion markers independently per message or update them transactionally.
